not_bugs_under_trusted_pin_contract: Re-signed removal of context row31 or change to a valid fixed rank can pass structural parsing. This does not bypass original expectedFileSha256: both mutations fail FileIdentity with its trusted pin. Decoder is intentionally not a canonical generator or arbitrary semantic-proof checker.

Current exact root/context/rank/fixed comparison matches reviewed input artifacts. Missing canonical context after29/30 is prevented by certified input identity, not inferable solely from sparse rows. Keep trusted full-file pins outside untrusted incoming cache bytes/manifest.
allocation_review: Header limit checked before payload ReadBytes; oversized case stops after16bytes. Payload <=2MiB; count multiplication uses long and remaining payload checks before arrays. Root <=65536cells, <=8192columns/96rows; context<=16384; ranks<=8192; each fixed set<=65536 and all limited by same payload.

Input stream is not required seekable: only in-memory payload stream Length/Position are used. EOF trailing check can block if caller provides a never-ending source; bounded seekless reader work is not a wall-time sandbox. Production should supply a bounded local asset/MemoryStream, not an unbounded network stream.

Reader copies payload and all retained source arrays/structures. Public results expose readonly values/accessors; owned Column,Template,UpperContext clone mutable constructor inputs. No caller byte-array retention was found.
provenance_review: export.py compares root and canonical Wood fixtures with prior cache-report SHA values, preserves explicit fixture source digests, and requires order/fixed bytes to match the selected canonical-run manifest. Checks.cs additionally compares every published root/context/order/fixed value with those original files.

The two selected canonical runs had already compared actual packed meshes and original reducer/mesh order. This decoder run preserves that evidence chain; it does not repeat full generation or independently establish new appearance semantics.

Exporter uses the prior local reports/manifests as authoring trust anchors. run.py detects changed inputs after export but should not be described as adversarial authentication of a replaced authoring manifest. Publication pins must be selected from the reviewed export manifest, not recomputed from incoming cache content.
scope: Read-only original source review + small adverse decoder tests; all new outputs isolated here, no runtime fulltree/pack/native work.
